name: Páty (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Páty: a blue shield with a yellow arm holding ears of grain, with a helm, an arm-and-sabre crest and red, yellow and blue mantling, above a scroll inscribed PÁTY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Páty arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
